usage: 南韓 is used as a proper noun to refer to the country South Korea.
You can use 南韓 when talking about travel, culture, or politics related to South Korea.
In Cantonese sentences, 南韓 often appears before verbs, like '南韓去' (go to South Korea) or '南韓文化' (South Korean culture).
It can be combined with other nouns to describe things from or related to South Korea, such as 南韓電影 (South Korean movies).
The word 南韓 is typically not pluralized since it refers to a country name.
